naive_formula_note.method: train wall at fraction 0.02 / 0.02 + full val
naive_formula_note.why_rejected: The 116.8 s at fraction 0.02 is ~89 s of one-time startup (weight load, AMP check, dataset scan) and only ~28 s of training. Dividing by 0.02 multiplies that startup by 50, inventing ~74 min of phantom time per epoch. The rate-based projection uses the measured 1.1 it/s instead.

verdict.note: D060 forbids Model A on MPS regardless; at 17.4 h it is also impractical. Model B at 3.9 h is a usable overnight fallback.
